text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas

Jalan (Larangan Pemanduan Kenderaan Barangan) (No. 2) 2023.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 20 April 2023.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan mana-mana jenis kenderaan barangan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (1) Jadual di atas mana-mana bahagian mana-mana jalan adalah dilarang

pada 20, 21, 24 dan 25 April 2023 pada masa yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

(2) Walau apa pun larangan dalam subkaedah (1), Menteri boleh

mengecualikan mana-mana jenis kenderaan barangan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual daripada larangan itu tertakluk kepada apa-apa syarat yang ditentukan olehnya.

JADUAL

[Kaedah 2]

(1) (2)

Jenis Kenderaan Barangan Masa Larangan

(a) Lori pembawa dan lori jongket yang berat

dengan muatannya melebihi 7,500 kg,

lori pengangkut rendah, treler tiang,

treler pelantar, lori balak, jentera berat

beroda, trak tunda dan traktor

(kecuali jentera berat beroda, trak tunda

dan traktor yang digunakan bagi maksud

operasi kecemasan dan menyelamat)

sepanjang masa

(b) Lori yang berat dengan muatannya

melebihi 7,500 kg yang mengangkut simen,

besi, keluli, batu, pasir, tanah, amang,

bijih timah, arang batu atau bahan binaan

atau bahan galian yang lain

sepanjang masa

(c) Lori kontena yang mengangkut barangan

(kecuali lori kontena yang mengangkut

barangan dari pelabuhan atau lapangan

terbang ke kawasan perindustrian

di dalam negeri yang sama atau sebaliknya)

dari 12.00 tengah malam

hingga 8.00 pagi

(1) (2)

Jenis Kenderaan Barangan Masa Larangan

(d) Lori kargo yang mengangkut barangan

elektronik atau elektrik atau bahan

industri kimia dari pelabuhan atau

lapangan terbang ke kawasan

perindustrian di dalam negeri yang sama

atau sebaliknya

dari 12.00 tengah malam

hingga 8.00 pagi

(e) Lori yang mengangkut tandan buah kelapa

sawit segar, produk kelapa sawit mentah,

getah sekerap dan susu getah

dari 12.00 tengah malam

hingga 8.00 pagi

(f) Lori kargo tanpa muatan dari 12.00 tengah malam

hingga 8.00 pagi

(g) Kren bergerak dan lori pembancuh simen

(kecuali kren bergerak yang digunakan

bagi maksud operasi kecemasan dan

menyelamat)

dari 6.00 petang hingga 6.00 pagi

dalam jarak 25 km dari tapak

pembinaan tertakluk kepada

had masa operasi yang

dibenarkan di atas jalan

tertentu

Dibuat 11 April 2023

[MOT.BD.(S).600/2/6/6 (1); PN(PU2)460/Jld. 124]

LOKE SIEW FOOK

Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRAFFIC (PROHIBITION ON DRIVING OF GOODS VEHICLES) (NO. 2) RULES 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 88(1)(c) and subsection 88(4)

of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister, after consultation with

the Minister charged with the responsibility for works, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Road Traffic (Prohibition on Driving

of Goods Vehicles) (No. 2) Rules 2023.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 20 April 2023.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of any type of goods vehicles specified in column (1) of the

Schedule on any part of any road is prohibited on 20, 21, 24 and 25 April 2023

at the time specified in column (2).

(2) Notwithstanding the prohibition in subrule (1), the Minister may exempt

any type of goods vehicles specified in column (1) of the Schedule from the prohibiton

subject to such conditions as he may determine.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

(1) (2)

Type of Goods Vehicle Time of Prohibition

(a) Carrier lorry and tipper lorry of which its

laden weight exceeds 7,500 kg,

low loader lorry, pole trailer,

platform trailer, timber lorry,

wheeled heavy machinery, tow truck and

tractor (except wheeled heavy machinery,

tow truck and tractor used for the purpose

of emergency and rescue operations)

at all times

(b) Lorry of which its laden weight

exceeds 7,500 kg transporting cement,

iron, steel, stones, sand, earth, tailing, tin,

coal or other construction materials or

mineral materials

at all times

(c) Container lorry transporting goods

(except container lorry transporting goods

from a port or an airport to an industrial

area in the same state or vice versa)

from 12.00 a.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(d) Cargo lorry transporting electronic or

electrical goods or chemical industry

material from a port or an airport to

an industrial area in the same state or

vice versa

from 12.00 a.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(1) (2)

Type of Goods Vehicle Time of Prohibition

(e) Lorry transporting fresh palm oil fruit

bunch, raw palm oil products, scrap rubber

and latex

from 12.00 a.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(f) Cargo lorry without a load from 12.00 a.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(g) Mobile crane and cement mixer lorry

(except mobile crane used for the purpose

of emergency and rescue operations)

from 6.00 p.m. to 6.00 a.m.

within 25 km from the

construction site subject to the

limit of the operation time

allowed on certain roads

Made 11 April 2023

[MOT.BD.(S).600/2/6/6 (1); PN(PU2)460/Jld. 124]

LOKE SIEW FOOK

Minister of Transport
